title: Window 6 (Agent 5's draft v2, finalized 2026-11-22 21:02 for build/agent2/devoff4b-bin): upload path on the S4b bin. s0 (every switch OFF) vs p2 = #8 P2, p2f = #8 + #5 fix (i), p2fc = #8 + #5 + #4 C1 v3 keep-watch (verify off); f and fc = the decision table's arms without P2
notes: W6 finalized 2026-11-22 21:02 for build/agent2/devoff4b-bin by build/agent5/w6-draft/finalize-w6.ps1 from Agent 5's draft v2 (matrix-w6.json): bin build/agent2/devoff4b-bin in every arm (legodimensions.exe sha256 DFBE1D43B28861A674663085B576E33B2D7E34D3D63A85CA480FF36CFE264B83). The gates before any timed run are G1-G12 in build/agent12/w6-gates/W6-GATES.md (v2, 20:20); build/agent5/w6-draft/README.md has the summary.

W6 (S4-DRAFT L346): run\run-matrix.ps1 -Matrix <this file> -Only s0,p2,p2f,p2fc -Repeats 3 -ColdShared -NoPrompt. One unscored cold run shared by all arms (they all use one bin), then 3 round-robin rounds rotated each round (3 rows of a 4x4 Latin square), with s0, p2, p2f and p2fc x3 each: 13 runs, about 33 min (S4-DRAFT L328). Overnight it starts from Agent 5's launcher (bench/agent5/launch/RUN-NIGHT.cmd) with the GO line 'GO W6 matrix-window6.json <sha256> only=s0,p2,p2f,p2fc repeats=3'; RUN-WINDOW6.cmd is the double-click fallback. Check with -PlanOnly first.

The arms differ only in these switches. p2 adds shared_memory_single_hold_rearm (#8 P2). p2f also adds physical_protect_hold_global_lock (#5 fix (i)). p2fc also adds physical_protect_keep_watch (#4 C1 v3) with physical_protect_keep_watch_verify=false. f = fix (i) alone and fc = f + C1 v3 (no P2), for the decision table's 'G4 FAIL, no cap' row only. Every other S4b switch stays at its default OFF (#7's hash log, M1, #18/#20 and the rest). Switches are set at launch only, hands off (G9): C1 v3 latches physical_protect_keep_watch and physical_protect_hold_global_lock at init (kInitOnly), so a console set never reaches Protect; physical_protect_keep_watch_verify and every other cvar are still read live.

Pairs (R3), all on the same bin: P2 = p2 - s0; fix (i) = p2f - p2; C1 = p2fc - p2f, with fix (i) ON in both arms (a12 S4.12 step 7; b2r §25 correction 3); stack = p2fc - s0. Read GPU Commands ms/f (threads.csv, the main metric), Main ms/f (C1 swaps Main's lock-time protects for write faults), fps and the slowest frames (perf.csv, summary.md). Per arm: median of 3 and min-max. Per pair: the difference of medians plus the 3 per-round differences. Noise rule: if the two arms' min-max ranges overlap, write 'no detectable change' with the median difference in brackets. A12 asks for 5 or more repeats (S4-DRAFT L322).

Never in a timing arm: #7's upload hash log (shared_memory_upload_hash_log, +1-3 ms/f on GPU Commands) or slow_frame_log_ms. Upload KB/f, kept protects per frame and P2's full-buffer counter come from untimed agent runs on the same bin: side 1 = p2f's set and side 2 = p2fc's set, both + shared_memory_upload_hash_log=true and slow_frame_log_ms=1; gate A = p2fc's set with physical_protect_keep_watch_verify=true and slow_frame_log_ms=1 over the title, the menu walk and one level load; side 3 (suggested) = p2fc's set + slow_frame_log_ms=1 on harness/routes/attract-long.txt. See W6-GATES.md, 'Untimed runs'.

Per-run validity (G10, S4-DRAFT L323-327): each run's slow state, >= 6 GB free, Defender below ~5 % (or the launcher's RELAXED gate, G12), and the log lines. Every p2fc and fc game.log needs 'C1 keep-watch: on (with physical_protect_hold_global_lock)' and 'C1 keep-watch: first kept protect at', and must have no 'C1 verify: on'. No arm may log 'Recovered stale physical page protection', 'Unhandled guest physical write fault' or 'PhysicalHeap::Protect failed' (b2r L1178). P2 and fix (i) print no line of their own: their ON proof is the cvar list the runner records per run; p2fc's init line also shows that fix (i) is ON.

Environment (G11, G12): keep sys_csv true. After the window: python build\agent12\w6-gates\w6_env_record.py <matrix out dir> --gate-log bench\agent5\launch\status\window-<id>-<HHmm>.log --json <out>. G11: one power overlay, scheme and AC in all 13 runs; if the overlay is not W5's best_efficiency, compare W6 only within itself. G12: the launcher's gate line says STRICT or RELAXED; RELAXED means a steady ~1 core of Defender through the window, which the round-robin spreads over all arms alike (quote the MsMpEng triple in R7).

Window as in windows 4 and 5: a 5 s settle and a 55 s warm-up from the first frame, then 50 s measured, so every window starts >= 60 s after the first frame (Agent 1's floor). The cold run has a 55 s warm-up and a 30 s window. Runner flags, frame source (perf.csv, uncapped) and driver (drivers/thread-cpu.ps1) as in window 5. Agent 5's launcher refuses arms with menu, profile, triggers, toml or seed_cache fields, bins other than build/agent2/<name>-bin with MANIFEST.txt and legodimensions.exe, and env keys other than REX_TIMER_WAIT_BLOCKING / LEGO_GPU_WAIT_STATS; this matrix has none of them (env {} in every arm).

Decision table (W6-GATES.md; Agent 1 decides). G4 PASS and C1 go: -Only s0,p2,p2f,p2fc -Repeats 3 (13 runs). G4 PASS and C1 no-go: -Only s0,p2 -Repeats 6 (1 + 12 = 13 runs; the runner rotates AB, BA, ...). G4 FAIL with a cap: rebuild with the cap, redo G2-G4, then row 1. G4 FAIL, no cap, C1 go: -Only s0,f,fc -Repeats 3 (10 runs, ~25 min); C1 = fc - f, fix (i) = f - s0. G4 FAIL, no cap, C1 no-go: Agent 1's call; not 's0 vs f only' (b2r L1181: fix (i) is timed only inside the C1 A/B).

Timing comes only from the user's unlocked desktop (screensaver None, AC power, hands off): the overnight launcher or a double-click. Agent runs of this matrix (-Quick, hidden desktop) are functional only (G3).

arms.note: s0 = the S4b bin with every switch OFF (S4-DRAFT L338 defines s0 the same way on S4a)

#8 P2 ON (Agent 12, build/agent12/s4-p2): one G hold across a range's valid-bit update and its watch re-arm. Timed only if P2's full-buffer counter totals 0 in the untimed runs (G4); otherwise Agent 1 decides a cap. No log line of its own.
#8 + #5 fix (i) ON (latched at init in C1 v3): C1's control arm. No log line of its own.

#8 + #5 + #4: C1 v3 keep-watch ON, verify off (keep_watch and hold_global_lock latched at init). Every game.log needs 'C1 keep-watch: on (with physical_protect_hold_global_lock)' and 'C1 keep-watch: first kept protect at', no 'C1 verify: on', and no stale-protection, unhandled-fault or 'PhysicalHeap::Protect failed' lines. Kept protects per frame: R4 (side 2 is the main source; timed p2fc runs are a cross-check).
Decision table only (G4 FAIL, no cap, C1 go): #5 fix (i) alone, C1's control arm without P2. Not in the normal -Only list.
Decision table only (G4 FAIL, no cap, C1 go): f + #4 C1 v3 keep-watch, verify off. Same log-line rules as p2fc. Not in the normal -Only list.
